mapper.select: SELECT coupon_id AS couponId, coupon_code AS couponCode, name, price, COALESCE(status, 'ON_SALE') AS status FROM coupons ORDER BY coupon_id ASC
SELECT total_point FROM students WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR CAST(id AS CHAR) = #{studentId}) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_purchase (price, name, state, created_date, student_id, coupon_id) VALUES( (SELECT price FROM coupons WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}), (SELECT name FROM coupons WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}), '사용전', NOW(), COALESCE((SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1), CAST(#{studentId} AS UNSIGNED)), #{couponId} )
mapper.select: SELECT cp.coupon_purchase_id AS couponPurchaseId, cp.name, cp.price, cp.state, cp.created_date as createdDate FROM coupon_purchase cp INNER JOIN coupons c ON cp.coupon_id = c.coupon_id WHERE (CAST(cp.student_id AS CHAR) = #{studentId} OR cp.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1) OR cp.student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY cp.created_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_purchase SET state = '사용' WHERE coupon_purchase_id = #{couponPurchaseId} AND (CAST(student_id AS CHAR) = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1) OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND state = '사용전'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(coupon_id) FROM coupon_purchase WHERE (CAST(student_id AS CHAR) = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1) OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1))
